title: Multi-head automated segmentation by incorporating detection head into the contextual layer neural network
mechanism: A parallel detection head gives a presence probability that gates segmentation, either soft (scale probabilities) or hard (threshold mask).
adaptation: Use it only as the soft or hard setting of the UNet 3+ presence-gate arm on inactive and crack. It does not need a separate run.
min_experiment: Run as the hard-gate setting inside the presence-head arm. Baseline: PF. Metric: inactive IoU and precision. Kill if hard gate < soft gate.
evidence: R: Dice loss 0.013 +/- 0.036 gated v 0.732 +/- 0.314 non-gated on Prostate-Anatomical-Edge-Cases (TCIA).
